description: test_wrong_typed_dynamic_value_blocks was moved from dialect sqlite to mysql but still uses a bare pytest.raises(RlsError) with no match= or message check, so criterion 7 (every moved refusal test asserts the reason) is unmet.

test_no_dialect_counts_pragma_functions relies on SQLite's pragma_ fallback-union entry under no dialect and has no MySQL counterpart in the same test (criterion 6); test_scope_failure_excludes_no_cte (1002-1014) has only a mysql-dialect sibling that pins the log line, not the None-dialect outcome.

The fake driver docstring says session setup statements never fetch their row, but the remove_sql_modes path runs SELECT @@SESSION.sql_mode and fetchone(); the fake answers it with (lower_case_table_names,).
Same docstring claim filed as comment drift: session setup never fetches a row, while the sql_mode read does.
FakeMySQL.kinds is keyed by relation name only and ignores the schema parameter, so the fake cannot represent schema-qualified catalog state.
Comment claims a test that reached a real connect would fail, but wrapped paths return the OperationalError as a structured result.
No test covers the lower_case_table_names 1/2 (mysql_fold, LOWER(...)) branch of the relation check; fails closed.
Internal doc still says test_sql_runner_event_loop.py checks the profile row cap and relation check on the sqllens-sql thread; the diff moved those tests to test_mysql_runner.py.

test_rls_query_shapes_return_scoped_rows creates both tables before try:, so a failed second CREATE TABLE leaves the first table on the live server; it also duplicates the _rls_guard helper's stack inline.
